newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goodman sees no takeover danger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goodman sees no takeover danger.

text.p: Australasian-based food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Friday there were no current signs that anyone was about to launch a takeover bid for the company.
"There's no evidence on the share register at all of anyone showing hostile intentions," Goodman Fielder chairman David Clarke told the company's annual meeting.
"I don't think at the current time there's any real likelihood of a takeover," he said.
Goodman Fielder is the perennial subject of takever speculation.

Earlier this year, large turnover in the food group's shares sparked rumours out of Singapore that the Camerlin group of Singaporean and Malaysian investment firms was a likely Goodman Fielder suitor.
